messages.content:
A question about machines at work (EU machinery law, Italian law on work equipment, guidance, manuals
of specific machines, a company's list of lifting devices) could not be answered from the passages found by its own
words. Break it into the lookups needed to answer it: each lookup is one thing to find in the documents (a
definition, the article that sets a duty, the list an annex gives, the date an article applies from, what a manual
declares about a machine, the row of a table).
Return JSON only: {"lookups": ["<search words for one lookup>", ...]} with 2 to 4 lookups. Write each lookup as
the words the document itself would use, in English and in Italian together, naming the act, the article or annex
and the machine when the question names them. Do not answer the question.
Can model CS-400 stay with internal production control after 20 January 2027?

response.text: {"lookups": ["Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 transitional provisions \"shall apply from 20 January 2027\" \"Directive 2006/42/EC repealed\" / Regolamento (UE) 2023/1230 disposizioni transitorie \"si applica a decorrere dal 20 gennaio 2027\" \"direttiva 2006/42/CE abrogata\"", "Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 Annex IV \"machinery referred to in Annex IV\" \"internal production control\" \"Module A\" / Regolamento (UE) 2023/1230 Allegato IV \"macchine di cui all'allegato IV\" \"controllo interno della produzione\" \"modulo A\"", "CS-400 manual declaration of conformity \"internal production control\" \"notified body\" / manuale CS-400 dichiarazione di conformità \"controllo interno della produzione\" \"organismo notificato\"", "Directive 2006/42/EC Annex IV \"internal production control\" \"Annex VIII\" machinery list / direttiva 2006/42/CE Allegato IV \"controllo interno della produzione\" \"Allegato VIII\" elenco delle macchine"]}
